description: **Core mechanic** : lands are the perfect sacrifice fodder — fetchlands crack themselves, Zuran Orb/Squandered Resources sac them for mana, and every land drop feeds Korvold's draw trigger (Landfall generators: Lotus Cobra, Tireless Provisioner).
**Engine** : landfall value (Tireless Provisioner, Lotus Cobra, Exploration) + land-sac outlets (Zuran Orb, Sylvan Safekeeper, Squandered Resources) + recursion (Aftermath Analyst, fetchlands).
**Payoff** : every land sacrificed draws a card and grows Korvold — the land base becomes a draw engine and the sac loops go infinite with Aftermath Analyst.
win: **Draw velocity** : each land sac replaces itself — keep the engine fed and out-draw everyone.
**Infinite loops** : Aftermath Analyst + sac outlet + fetchland = infinite landfall triggers and Korvold draws.
**Commander damage** : a 10/10+ flying Korvold closes in 2 hits after the land engine churns.

combos.manaNeeded: {2}{G} plus enough mana to animate the land
combos.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
combos.description:
Earthbend a land, thus animating it.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated land.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the land it is attached to.
When the land token enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 5.

combos.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
You control at least eight lands.
combos.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Lotus Cobra triggers that many times, adding {G} for each land that entered the battlefield this way.
Repeat.
Resolve all Sylvan Safekeeper abilities.
combos.notes: If you control nine or more lands, this combo will net infinite mana due to Lotus Cobra's trigger.

combos.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and draw a card.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

description: **Core mechanic** : Korvold's draw engine finds the pieces; the sac loops (Plunderer + Altar, Gravecrawler + outlet) generate infinite mana/draw/drain.
**Engine** : 2-3 card loops around sacrifice outlets and recursive pieces.
**Payoff** : infinite mana into a big X-spell, infinite drain, or a massive Korvold.
win: **Infinite mana** : Pitiless Plunderer + Ashnod's Altar + any recursive creature.
**Infinite drain** : add Zulaport Cutthroat/Mayhem Devil to the loop.
**Tutor shell** : the draw engine finds the missing combo piece fast.

description: **Core mechanic** : Korvold turns every permanent you sacrifice into a +1/+1 counter AND a card — the classic Jund sac engine (Mayhem Devil pings, Viscera Seer/Ashnod's Altar fuel the loop).
**Engine** : sacrifice outlets + token/fetch fodder + draw-on-sac triggers (Korvold himself, Grim Haruspex-type effects).
**Payoff** : a giant flying Korvold that draws into more sac fodder every turn.
win: **Draw into value** : every sacrifice replaces itself — keep the engine fed and never run out of gas.

**Mayhem Devil drain** : each sacrifice pings the table for 1-2, finishing low life totals.

text: **Lands Matter (420) and Combo (638) are co-favorites**: 9/10 HS overlap each — the deck IS a lands-combo machine (Shifting Woodland + Aftermath Analyst loops, Squandered Resources + fetchlands, Lotus Cobra/Tireless Provisioner landfall engines).
**Sacrifice (1,626) is the natural backdrop**: 8/10 overlap — Korvold's draw trigger feeds on the same sac outlets (Sylvan Safekeeper, Squandered Resources, Orcish Lumberjack).

**Combo density is extreme**: Underworld Breach + Lion's Eye Diamond + Wheel of Fortune (86k decks), Springheart Nantuko + Tireless Provisioner (89k), Chatterfang + Pitiless Plunderer (61k) — the deck closes via loops, not combat.
**Structural profile = cEDH combo**: 34 lands, avg nonland CMC 1.91, 0 board wipes, 1 interaction slot — the deck races to its combo by turn 3-4 and has almost no defensive game.
**Verdict**: a tuned Bracket-4 lands-combo list — the fastest, most efficient version of the Korvold Lands plan. It is NOT a balanced casual deck (0 wipes, 1 removal = glass-cannon).
